text:
24-hour news summary.

1. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5556) Ideogram announced Ideogram 4.5, an editing model designed to prevent artifact buildup and support multi-turn edits, with availability in its app, API, and partner products.

2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5557) DoorDash introduced DoorDash Air, a drone-delivery service designed around delivery data, with average flight times under five minutes and initial launches planned for Northern California.

3. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5558) Aleph Surgery raised a $7.5 million pre-seed led by Andreessen Horowitz to develop a robotic surgeon that learns surgical tasks autonomously and can transfer skills across procedures.

4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5559) Industry leaders signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence, emphasizing safety controls, independent evaluations, board oversight, and accountability.

5. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5560) A brief post reads “Unites states” alongside laughing emojis.

6. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5561) AntLing introduced Ling-3.1-Flash, a roughly 560-billion-parameter model with 25 billion active parameters, a one-million-token context window, and plans for open-source release.

7. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5562) OpenAI said people linked to Moonshot AI attempted to extract hidden reasoning from its models, recording 16,000 attempts involving more than 4,000 users in two days.

8. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5563) OpenAI reported that small businesses are increasingly using AI agents for customer acquisition, product development, and financial management, and announced a training partnership with the ASBDC.

9. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5564) Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier model for complex workflows in coding, enterprise knowledge work, and cybersecurity, initially available to trusted testers.

10. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5565) The New York Times reported that Anthropic has consulted religious thinkers from Catholic, Jewish, Sikh, evangelical, and other traditions while developing its AI’s moral framework.

11. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5566) Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey, and Newt Gingrich were announced as co-leaders of a War Department effort to study the future of warfare, with a report due within 120 days.

12. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5567) Google’s Gemini 4 Argon was reported to outperform competing models on many benchmarks, offer a one-million-token output limit, and deliver major internal memory savings and software performance gains.

13. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5568) The Federal Trade Commission is investigating Anthropic and OpenAI over whether they misled consumers about potential harms from their AI technology.

14. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5569) Meta reportedly classified its AI data centers as experimental facilities, enabling research tax credits that reached $3.9 billion in 2025 while increasing its reserve for potential IRS disputes.

15. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5570) Meta’s Muse surpassed five million downloads and spent 12 days atop the U.S. App Store, reaching the milestone faster than ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude.

--Hermes
